title: AI has discovered all jokes and comedy has now been completed
key_facts: NewsBiscuit is a British satire site; the piece is fiction, not news
The joke premise: AI has absorbed the whole internet and every dad-joke book and declared comedy complete
It mocks AI output as Gemini copies of Claude copies of Copilot copies of a Grok comment
It invents 'quantum comedy' that is funny and not funny at once
It jokes that humans can no longer write original material
quote_evidence: It has been announced that AI has discovered all jokes and there are no new humorous phrases or actions left.
It is now creating quantum comedy, which is both funny and not funny at the same time
why_it_matters_hint: Satire poking at the sameness of AI-generated humour
notes: Satire; nothing here is a factual claim. Status is nominal.
